purpose: Opt-in physical support and explicitly owned equilibrium-cut resultants; not structural/design acceptance

upstream.build_driver: package/local-completion/calculix-9zt-probe/build_probe.py --patch package/calculix/force-accounting/hooks.patch --extra-source package/calculix/force-accounting/forceaccounting.c --runtime-prefix <stable dependency prefix>; also supply --source-archive, --recipe and new --workdir

interface.output: <request path>.out; header, final STATE, named SUPPORT/CUT/LOAD/CONTACT six-component rows, END
interface.state: Final converged output state of one static step; importer requires the exact requested end time
interface.support_request: SUPPORT <name> <reference node> <rotation node>; exact declared native RBE identities, all six prescribed at zero
interface.body_request: BODY <name> <element count> <cut-node count>, followed by explicit element IDs and complete shared-interface node IDs
interface.ownership: Cut-body selection is explicit. Native topology checks reject undeclared shared-node interfaces, body SPCs/MPCs and ambiguous cut-node concentrated loads. A contact side must have one exterior parent volume, including matching midside identities.
interface.support_semantics: Native internal nodal force minus actual consistent external element/nodal loads, projected together through native decascaded MPC coefficients. Rotation port is a reference-point couple; native code translates it to the global origin.
interface.cut_semantics: Equilibrium-derived force and global-origin moment acting ON the declared AccountingBody across its only shared-node interface: -(native applied body/pressure/concentrated loads + native contact forces on that body). No recovered-stress integration and no reconstructed body loads.
interface.contact_semantics: Native face-to-face spring nodal force contributions, negated from the internal-force assembly sign and attributed separately to actual master and slave parent volumes. Each side's moment uses its own original nodal application positions. No slave-moment sign flip is used as a master-moment substitute.
interface.load_semantics: Actual native consistent element RHS before active-DOF filtering; concentrated loads included once when body ownership is unambiguous
interface.frame: Global Cartesian, original reference-state nodal positions; FreeCAD writer units N and Nmm
interface.ordinary_channels: RF, SOF/SOM and CF remain unchanged. SOF/SOM is still recovered/extrapolated/averaged stress integration; CF moments still use deformed slave positions. The new output is separately named and is not numerically interchangeable with those channels.

supported_domain.solver: Standalone 32-bit-integer CalculiX 2.23 plus pinned build-8 fixes and this extension
supported_domain.analysis: One small-displacement mechanical implicit static step, original global coordinates
supported_domain.mesh: C3D4/C3D10 solids with current native CAD entity ownership metadata for FreeCAD cut selection
supported_domain.contact: Triangular face-to-face penalty contact, frictionless or frictional; both master/slave ownership directions
supported_domain.supports: Disjoint native RBE regions, all six motions prescribed at zero
supported_domain.cut_bodies: Explicit solid unions, no SPC/MPC inside the selected body, complete single declared shared-node cut interface
supported_domain.limits: At most 64 named supports and 64 free-body requests per run; no multi-step reuse or in-process CalculiXstep reuse

FreeCAD_use.solver: Enable NativeForceAccounting on CalculiXCcxTools. Empty NativeAccountingSolver selects the separately bundled qualified executable, not the user's ordinary ccx preference.
FreeCAD_use.cut: Enable NativeEquilibriumCut on a Section Force object and select AccountingBody solid(s) owning the selected one-sided facets. The reported wrench acts on that explicit body; do not fit signs to targets.
FreeCAD_use.result: Separate Native force accounting (N, Nmm) object with readable resultants and JSON provenance: deck/request/binary/output hashes, model fingerprint, frame, load/contact terms and applicability
FreeCAD_use.staleness: Model changes invalidate current accounting; cold restoration is explicitly historical until rerun. Failed/partial, nonfinite, wrong-time, wrong-identity and inconsistent outputs are not imported as current.
FreeCAD_use.deployment: Optional CMake FREECAD_NATIVE_CCX_ACCOUNTING points to the qualified executable. App data/NativeSolvers carries the separate binary and source/contract/license. Standard ccx and global preferences are not replaced.

qualification.tolerance: Declared analytic fixtures compare both force-vector norm and global-origin moment-vector norm to unchanged 1% limits; no zero-error prerequisite
qualification.coverage: GRAV under whole/face RBE, Tet4/Tet10, offset support references; deformable cuts with native GRAV, pressure and point loads, frictional contact, swapped master/slave, rotated/translated global frames; rejection and production import/restore checks
qualification.meaning: Software/output-method qualification only. Equilibrium-derived cuts do not independently validate stresses, constitutive/contact accuracy, mesh convergence, strength or building design. No universal 1% mesh guarantee.
qualification.original_Oomakhi: Not replayed or accepted. Frozen R42 force error 1.075520426516643%, origin moment error 1.1325582974510988%, original 1% limits and all 96 failed local checks remain unchanged. Any resolution claim requires actual new outputs for that fixture and independent review.
